newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China fertilizer producer to offer A shares.
newsitem.headline: China fertilizer producer to offer A shares.

text.p: Fertilizer producer Shenzhen Liaohe Tongda Chemical Industry Co Ltd has received approval to offer 130 million A shares and list them on the Shenzhen stock exchange, an official involved in the issue said on Tuesday.

The offer is expected to be launched via the exchange's automated quotation system by the end of this year, an official at the Ministry of Chemical Industry, which supports the issue, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The pricing and timetable for the offer have yet to be fixed, the official said.
Tongda originally applied to issue 200 million A shares but the China Securities Regulatory Commission only approved an issue of 130 million, the official said.

Shenzhen J&A Securities has been named chief underwriter for the offer, he added. Tongda is headquartered in Shenzhen but its production facilities are located in Liaoning province in northeastern China.
Tongda aims to use the offer proceeds to take over the Liaoning-based Jinxi Natural Gas Chemical Plant to expand Tongda's fertilizer production capacity, the official said.
He said Tongda had forecast profits of about 220 million yuan for 1996, compared with about 160 million yuan last year and 140 million yuan in 1994.
After the A shares are listed, Tongda plans to apply to offer 120 million B shares also for listing in Shenzhen, the official said without giving further details.
